candidate.title: oxBS-Seq
candidate.scope: The oxBS-Seq middle row of the assigned Illumina poster: the depicted KRuO4 oxidative-bisulfite workflow and its parallel conventional-bisulfite control, at chemical-conversion and DNA-readout scope. The card title, row label and matching collection-page heading identify this target. CAB-Seq above, RedBS-Seq/caMAB-seq below, and the biotin legend at right are neighboring context with no depicted transfer into oxBS-Seq. The conventional-bisulfite control is an embedded comparison component, not an additional target method. Sequencing and paired-library interpretation are explicitly distinguished as interfaces supported by the matching secondary catalogue text beyond the poster row's terminal DNA symbol. This is not a complete library-preparation implementation.

states.label: DNA containing cytosine and its depicted modifications
features: The highlighted 5hmc residue identifies the biological target within DNA; it is an explanatory location icon, not a separate chemical step.

The example strand displays, in order, unmodified C, 5-methylcytosine (5mC), 5-hydroxymethylcytosine (5hmC), 5-formylcytosine (5fC), and 5-carboxylcytosine (5caC). These five positions illustrate base fates, not a required genomic sequence.
The two routes represent control and oxidation-treated DNA from the starting material. No attachment, compartment, adapter, index or consequential end group is specified.

states.label: Position-associated 5mC and 5hmC interpretation
features: The oxidized-branch C signal represents 5mC; comparison with the control C signal permits an estimate of 5hmC at corresponding positions.
The inference uses two branch measurements, not direct sequencing of a hydroxymethyl group or physical pooling of DNA products.

The schematic does not establish perfect chemical conversion, quantitative recovery or error-free subtraction. Pre-existing 5fC and 5caC yield T in both routes and are not separately identified by this pair.

operations.label: Bisulfite treatment / PCR amplification
operations.description: Process the control strand through the captioned bisulfite treatment and PCR block. The depicted input identities C, 5mC, 5hmC, 5fC and 5caC become the DNA letters T, C, C, T and T. These two captioned actions are retained as one broad depicted block.
